% List labels where LaTeX sets them, checked by visual.mjs: in a note,
% whose leading is smaller than the label's; in \small text; on an item
% that starts with a display, a nested list, a picture, a top-aligned
% minipage or tabular, or text or a picture before a display; in
% enumerate, enumitem's lists, and a description; with a label wider than
% its column; and in algorithmicx
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,graphicx,enumitem,algpseudocode}
\newlist{steps}{enumerate}{1}
\setlist[steps]{label=Step \arabic*., leftmargin=*}
\newlist{terms}{description}{1}
\begin{document}
A paragraph with a note.\footnote{A note with a list:
\begin{itemize}\item first in a note\item second in a note\end{itemize}}

{\small Small text:
\begin{itemize}\item one in small\item two in small\end{itemize}}

\begin{itemize}
\item \[ x = y. \]
\item \begin{align} a &= b \end{align}
\item \begin{equation} c = d \end{equation}
\item Text before \[ e = f. \]
\item \includegraphics[alt={picture}, width=40pt]{test-picture.png} before \[ g = h. \]
\item \begin{itemize}\item nested first\item nested second\end{itemize}
\item \includegraphics[alt={picture}, width=40pt]{test-picture.png} after a picture
\item \begin{minipage}[t]{100pt}a minipage of two lines, which is wrapped\end{minipage}
\item \begin{tabular}[t]{ll} a & b\\ c & d \end{tabular}
\item[A long label] wider than its column
\end{itemize}

\begin{enumerate}\item an enumerated item\end{enumerate}
\begin{steps}\item a step\end{steps}
\begin{itemize}[label=$\star$]\item a starred item\end{itemize}
\begin{terms}\item[Term] a term of enumitem\end{terms}
\begin{description}\item[Word] a description\end{description}

\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Require $x > 0$
\State $y \gets x$
\end{algorithmic}
\end{document}
